why_confidence: Neither half of the ask is enforceable from object definitions: the data rule depends on runtime copies and environment separation, and the access rule depends on an org on-call process. No candidate template or check covers either part, so I wrote no policy. Confidence that a policy achieves the goal is low by design, since none was written.
